description: Nvidia undervolting and overclocking tool for Linux. Automatically scans for GPU voltage-frequency curves (efficiency-performance) and applies them adaptively based on the pre frame-gen FPS. Profiles per specific Steam game. MSI Afterburner profile imports and LACT profile exports.
